text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. My heart dances with 
excitement...! After all, this year's 
summer training camp means we can unleash 
everything without reservation!
choice_data_list:
...Yeah, things are different from last 
year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Part of me feels truly happy about that.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I shall surrender myself completely to the 
scorching heat. And sharpen myself to the 
absolute limit!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, summer training camp for her 
second Tenno Sho (Autumn) had begun!"
